name: Dynamic Climate & Ecological Land Use
short_description:
[b]Lazy, formula-driven climate for EU5[/b]: per-location temperature, humidity, vapour pressure and wet-bulb; regional macro weather fronts (heatwaves, polar vortices, monsoons); climate-driven modifiers for locations and armies; a cultivated-vs-wilderness land-use system with yearly drift; a Climate tab in the location window. Identical rules for player and AI.

[b]Incompatible with Ecology Simulation (eu5-ecology-mod) — disable that mod before enabling this one.[/b]
